_Description: Fallback protocol (see opts.protocol.fallback): proton-density weighted (turbo) spin echo of all vendors and field strengths (2D, e.g. the dual-echo PD/T2 of NKI or clinical protocols, or 3D) with long TR and short TE, with up to 2 volumes and the spin-echo scanning sequence (i.e. without EPI, e.g. SBRef or time series)
